name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Ah, a summoner's orb--this is where the taint must be coming from. We must exorcise the demon within it if you're to use it. That I can do easily.

You're the one who has the hard job.  You must kill the demon once I release it.

And you'll have to be quick.  If you take too long then he'll return to the orb and we'll have to start over!

So get yourself ready, adventurer.  Prepare your strongest spells and keep your potions handy, and go get a friend if you have one.  Because this isn't going to be pretty.
narrative.objectives: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Nicely done, adventurer!  You gave that demon a lesson he won't soon forget. You've shown great power and skill. Now I suppose it's time you return to Menara with your cleansed orb so you can put it to good use.

Good luck, Champion. Perhaps our paths will cross again.
narrative.requestItemsText: You'll have to kill that demon to remove its presence permanently from the orb, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 9 quests from level 35 to 40, 16,200 XP in all.

quests.name: Fragments of the Orb of Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Menara's acolytes inside the tower above Ratchet and choose one of their paths to follow. Afterwards, bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

quests.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
quests.objectiveText: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

quests.name: The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.
